description: Generates candidate binder peptides for a target protein using the PepMLM-650M masked language model — appends <mask> tokens to the target sequence and samples amino acids at each position, with illegal residues (X, B, Z) excluded from the sampling candidates. Reports pseudo-perplexity for each candidate, supports reproducible generation via an explicit random seed, and provides offline filtering and parameter-sweep analysis that needs no GPU. This skill should be used when designing peptides or protein fragments that should bind a target, generating a ranked candidate pool for a target sequence, or comparing how peptide length and top-k sampling settings affect candidate quality.
